selection_rationale: Fixed main absorption complex based on full unshifted raw profiles; weak 1611 included from outset to constrain saturated gas. Separate absorption around −157 (2382) and −170/+133 (1611) outside common window; identities not established. Left boundary wing sensitivity retained as limitation. All source-valid pixels retained, no residual-based masks; model adequacy judged before offsets.
pre_fit_limitations: Weak 1611 overlaps a conservative strong-sky proxy near 5897 Å; no exposure-specific sky correction verified.
The common window isolates the main complex only; a nearby blue 2382 feature has unknown identity and possible wings.
Both reference 2374 and strong 2382 contain saturated pixels; weak 1611 is included from the outset to constrain columns.
Selection after profile inspection is exploratory; no anomalous shift or fitted residual was used.
